title: BalanceConfig
description: A balance profile, balance/<profile>.yaml (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §4.1, §6). Keys land with the code that reads them. x-unit names each value's unit and, for durations, its clock (CFG-5, CFG-9); x-hot-reload is the §6 HR column. Fixed values use minimum = maximum, not const: const generates a Literal that also accepts true and 1.0.

schema_version.description: File format version, unitless; the loader accepts only 1 (§4.4).

Campaign.description: Campaign clock, end conditions, timed objectives and momentum (§6.6, GAMEPLAY §9; NX-126). Durations are game time, converted to ticks at load.

time_limit_h.description: Game hours of running clock until the time limit ends the campaign, unit h of game time (Q-GD-29, Q-TEST-6).

victory_node_frac.description: Share of strategic nodes (AIRBASE, FOB, PORT) the coalition must hold to win, unit fraction (GAMEPLAY §9).

victory_hold_min.description: Game minutes the coalition must hold victory_node_frac without a dip, unit min of game time (GAMEPLAY §9).

objective_period_min.description: Game minutes an objective lasts before it expires, unit min of game time (GAMEPLAY §9, STATE-MACHINES 4.5).

objective_mode.description: timed: one system objective at a time; off: none (Q-GD-19). Set per campaign by the owner or an admin (Q-ALN-10).

average_weight.description: Points for a side's whole average share of strategic nodes over the campaign, unit points (STATE-MACHINES 4.4, Q-SIM-64).

final_weight.description: Points for a side's share of strategic nodes at the final tick, unit points (STATE-MACHINES 4.4, Q-SIM-64).

objective_points.description: Points to the coalition per completed objective, unit points (STATE-MACHINES 4.4).

momentum.description: Momentum weights (Q-SIM-60): momentum % = nodes_weight x the coalition's share of strategic nodes + supply_weight x its supply fill. They must add up to 100.

nodes_weight.description: Weight of the coalition's share of strategic nodes, unit percentage points.

supply_weight.description: Weight of the coalition's supply fill, unit percentage points.

defeat.description: The coalition's defeat (Q-TH-7, GAMEPLAY §9, NX-124 part 3).

hold_min.description: Game minutes the coalition sanctuary's defense HP must stay at 0 before the campaign is lost, unit min of game time (Q-TH-7).

Air.description: Aircraft fuel and idle orbit (§6.1, NX-368).

bingo_reserve_frac.description: Fuel kept in reserve at bingo, unit fraction of the kind's fuel_s: an airborne aircraft returns to base once its fuel is at most the flight time to the nearest base it can land at plus this reserve (STATE-MACHINES §4.1, NX-368).

orbit_period_s.description: One lap of an idle airborne aircraft's orbit at its min_speed_mps, unit s of world time; the radius is min_speed_mps x orbit_period_s / 2 pi (SIM-CORE §4, NX-368).

radius_m.description: A ground unit this close to a node counts for its capture, unit m (GAMEPLAY §8, Q-SIM-57).

time_s.description: World seconds one capturer takes to fill a node's capture bar before the quiet-stream and garrison modifiers, unit s of world time (GAMEPLAY §8).

multi_unit_exponent.description: Diminishing returns: the capture time is divided by n to this power, n the weighted capturers in radius, unit exponent (Q-SIM-26).

quiet_floor.description: The quiet-stream multiplier on the coalition's capture time at 0 live viewer units, rising linearly to 1.0 at quiet_ref, unit multiplier (Q-SIM-26).

quiet_ref.description: Live viewer units at which the quiet-stream multiplier reaches 1.0, unit viewer units (Q-SIM-26).

min_time_s.description: The shortest a capture may take, before the garrison modifier, unit s of world time (Q-GP-4).

logi_weight.description: How much of a capturer a logistics unit counts for, unit capturer weight (Q-SM-7).

garrison_mult.description: Capture-time multiplier while a defender that cannot contest (parked air, an unarmed ground unit) is at the base, unit multiplier (Q-GD-32, Q-SM-8).

empty_base_mult.description: Capture-time multiplier while the owning side has no unit at the base, unit multiplier (Q-GD-32, Q-SM-8).

decay_per_s.description: Share of the capture bar that drains per world second while the capturers are gone, unit fraction of the bar per s of world time (Q-SIM-23, Q-SIM-57). Counted in millionths of a percent per tick, rounded.

defense_hp.description: The most defense HP a node of each kind has (Q-SIM-71, GAMEPLAY §8): an owned node starts full, a NEUTRAL one at 0, and a node that changes hands starts at 0 for its new owner. A BRIDGE has none here (NX-373).

sanctuary_repair_hp_per_s.description: Defense HP per world second that each friendly logistics unit parked at its side's SANCTUARY (no path, not Disabled) rebuilds there, from the sanctuary's infinite supply with no stock debit, unit hp per s of world time per unit (GAMEPLAY §9, Q-SIM-71). Counted in thousandths of an hp per tick, rounded.

Combat.description: Combat (§6.4, COMBAT; NX-124). Only the keys the built parts read.

pk_cap.description: Highest hit probability: every shot can miss, unit probability (CB-4, Q-CBT-10).

track_quality.description: Pk multiplier by how the shooter's side knows the target (COMBAT §5.2).

painted.description: A target painted by a recon unit, unit multiplier.

full_pk_frac.description: Share of a weapon's range_m with the full range factor, unit fraction of range_m.

min_mult.description: Range factor at range_m, unit multiplier; it falls linearly from 1.0 at full_pk_frac.

pk_mult.description: Other Pk multipliers (COMBAT §5.2); the unbuilt factors are the registered 1.0 fallback FB-6.

terrain_masked.description: A NOE or LOW aircraft, or a ground unit inside a theater masking region, unit multiplier (Q-CBT-11, Q-FOW-3).

damage_state.description: Damage-state thresholds (CB-6, Q-GP-8): a unit is in the state when its hp is below the fraction of its kind's hp; they descend.

damaged_below.description: Below this hp fraction a unit is Damaged, unit fraction of hp.

mission_kill_below.description: Below this hp fraction a unit is Mission-kill, unit fraction of hp.

disabled_below.description: Below this hp fraction a unit is Disabled, and a facility's hp floors there, unit fraction of hp.

damaged_speed_mult.description: Top-speed multiplier of a unit at Damaged or worse; an aircraft never flies below its min_speed_mps, unit multiplier (CB-6, Q-SIM-65).

damaged_sensor_mult.description: Sensor-radius multiplier of a unit at Damaged or worse, unit multiplier (CB-6, Q-SIM-65).

assist_window_s.description: A shooter that landed a hit on a unit within this long before the unit is destroyed is an assist on its UnitDestroyed, unit s of game time (COMBAT CB-5a, Q-SIM-66).

disabled_timeout_s.description: A Disabled unit that is not a facility is removed after this long, unit s of game time (CB-7, Q-CBT-14).

crew_survival.description: Chance a crew survives the loss of its unit (DOWNED, else LOST), one entry per kind with crew above 0, unit probability; the unit's one roll on the combat stream (CB-8, Q-SIM-68).

ENEMY_ARMOR.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

ENEMY_CONVOY.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

ENEMY_FIGHTER.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

ENEMY_STRIKE_FIGHTER.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

GARRISON_INFANTRY.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

LOGI_TRUCK.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

STRIKE_FIGHTER.description: Crew survival chance of this kind, unit probability.

crew_marker_min.description: A downed crew stays a map marker this long, unit min of game time (CB-8, Q-SIM-68).

Fow.description: Fog of war (§6.1, FOG-OF-WAR FOW-5, FOW-6a, FOW-9, Tier 1; NX-150).

paint_range_m.description: A recon unit paints a target it tracks with its own sensor within this range, unit m (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 2 painted flag, Q-FOW-6).

sigint_cell_m.description: Side of the square SIGINT cell that blobs aggregate into and are drawn at, unit m (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1, FOW-2).

sigint_range_mult.description: A SIGINT blob forms within this multiple of a friendly radar site's sensor radius, unitless multiplier (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1, Q-FOW-7).

sigint_refresh_s.description: SIGINT blobs are rebuilt after this much running world time, unit s of world time, frozen while paused (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-5, FOW-9).

sigint_size_l_min.description: A SIGINT blob of at least this many units reads L, unit count; must be above sigint_size_m_min (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1).

sigint_size_m_min.description: A SIGINT blob of at least this many units reads M (fewer reads S), unit count; must be below sigint_size_l_min (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 1).

track_every_ticks.description: Tier 2 tracks are computed on ticks where tick % track_every_ticks == 0, unit ticks (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-5, Q-FOW-6).

track_fade_s.description: A last-known track is dropped after this long untracked, unit s of world time, frozen while paused (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-6a, FOW-9).

Logistics.description: Node stock and trucks (§6.3, GAMEPLAY §5; NX-123 part 1).

node_max_stock.description: The most stock a node of each kind holds, unit stock units; a theater's start_stock may not exceed its kind's. SANCTUARY (and so the Static's rear source) is infinite by rule and has no entry (Q-SIM-49).

starve_threshold.description: A base is starved below this fraction of its node_max_stock, unit fraction; a truck never loads stock below it, so the floor is ceil(starve_threshold x max) whole units (GAMEPLAY §5, Q-GP-24).

truck_cargo.description: The most cargo a truck loads, unit stock units; one global value for every cargo-carrying kind (GAMEPLAY §5).

unload_rate.description: Stock a parked truck moves into its destination per world second, unit stock per s of world time, frozen while paused (GAMEPLAY §5, Q-SIM-50). Counted in whole milli-units per tick, so it is rounded to 0.001 per tick.

rearm_rate.description: Stock a landed aircraft buys at a base per world second, unit stock per s of world time, frozen while paused (Q-SIM-51). Counted in whole milli-units per tick, so it is rounded to 0.001 per tick.

forward_deploy_min_surplus.description: Stock a spawn base must hold above its starvation floor, unit stock units, before a JOIN may forward-deploy there (GAMEPLAY GP-7, Q-SIM-54).

starved_loadout.description: What a base below its starvation floor fills a landed unit up to (Q-SIM-53).

fuel_frac.description: Share of the kind's fuel_s a starved base refuels an aircraft up to, unit fraction.

loadout_cost.description: Stock a unit's full loadout costs, unit stock units: debited from the base it forward-deploys at (GP-7) and the price of a full refill at a base (Q-SIM-51). One entry per kind that can spawn by JOIN or director; facilities are placed by the theater and have none. 0 for the cargo kinds, which pay by loading cargo (Q-SIM-49).

repair_rate.description: Hp a unit or facility at a friendly base of each kind repairs per world second, unit hp per s of world time, frozen while paused; SANCTUARY repairs free and every other kind spends the base's stock (GAMEPLAY §5, §5b, Q-SIM-68). Counted in whole thousandths of an hp per tick.

AIRBASE.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

FOB.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

HQ.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

PORT.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

SANCTUARY.description: Repair rate at a base of this kind, unit hp per s (world).

facility_repair_hp_per_stock.description: Hp of a facility that one stock unit of its base repairs, unit hp per stock unit (GAMEPLAY §5b, Q-SIM-68); a unit pays loadout_cost x the share of its hp repaired instead.

facility_rearm_cost.description: Stock a facility's base pays for a full reload of all the facility's weapons, unit stock units, in proportion to the ammo share used (GAMEPLAY §5b, Q-SIM-69); free at a sanctuary.

starve_hp_drain_per_min.description: Defense HP a base below its starvation floor loses per game minute, unit hp per min of game time (GAMEPLAY §8, Q-SIM-71); 0 turns the drain off. Whole hp, carried across ticks.

defense_repair_hp_per_stock.description: Defense HP one stock unit unloaded into a node rebuilds, unit hp per stock unit (GAMEPLAY §8, Q-SIM-71), up to the node's defense_hp.

tick_hz.description: Kernel tick rate, unit Hz; fixed at 10 by ADR-0002, validated, not tunable (SIM-CORE SC-2).

time_scale.description: World seconds per real second while the campaign runs, unit multiple of real time (SIM-CORE SC-2, CFG-9).

Tasking.description: Tasking Board (§6.7, GAMEPLAY §1b, Q-SIM-73; NX-374). Both sides' boards use these keys. Durations are game time, converted to ticks at load. Priority points are `priority.<job_kind>` x urgency (1.0 to urgency_max) + priority_aging_per_min x game minutes waited.

reeval_every_ticks.description: A board re-evaluates (settles, generates, assigns) every this many running ticks (TB-6), unit ticks.

claim_lease_s.description: A claim with no progress for this long is released and the job returns to OPEN (TB-1, Q-ALN-23), unit s of game time.

expire_min.description: An unclaimed job expires this long after it was posted (Q-SIM-73), unit min of game time. Objective jobs expire with the objective instead.

priority.description: Base priority per job kind (Q-GP-20), unit points; keys are the lower-case JobKind. Repair-bridge joins with its job.

urgency_max.description: The most the triggering condition can multiply a base priority by (Q-GP-20), unit multiplier; the least is 1.0.

priority_aging_per_min.description: Priority points an open job gains per game minute it has waited (TB-3, Q-ALN-23), unit points/min of game time.

slots.description: Units a job needs (TB-4), by lower-case JobKind; resupply is sized from the missing stock instead (resupply_stock_per_slot).

resupply_stock_per_slot.description: A resupply job gets one slot per this much missing stock (max stock minus stock, rounded up, at least one), unit stock units.

resupply_slots_max.description: The most slots a resupply job gets, unit units.

defend_radius_m.description: A friendly base posts a defend job when its side tracks an enemy ground unit within this distance of it (Q-SIM-74), unit m. Urgency rises as the nearest tracked enemy closes: 1.0 at the radius, the cap at the base.

counterattack_window_min.description: For this long after a side loses a node, its AI garrison may take strike and assist-objective jobs against it (Q-GD-31, Q-SIM-74), unit min of game time.

scout_cooldown_min.description: A scout job whose cell still holds a blob after it was DONE is not posted again for this long (Q-SIM-75), unit min of game time.

follow_station_m.description: Where a follower keeps station on its direct leader (Q-GP-32, Q-SIM-76), unit m: `escort` a ground combat unit ahead of a truck or convoy on the same road; `column` a ground unit behind a ground leader; `overwatch` the radius an aircraft orbits within over a ground unit; `wingman` an aircraft's distance off an aircraft lead.

escort_threat_memory_s.description: An armed follower treats a tracked enemy that fired at any member of its convoy or column this recently as a threat to the group and engages it (Q-SIM-76), unit s of world time.

escort_leash_m.description: The farthest an armed follower leaves its station from the nearest other member of its group to engage a group threat; beyond it, it returns to station and a threat that far is not chased (Q-SIM-76), unit m.

max_live_per_commander.description: Live personal units per commander, unit units (GAMEPLAY GP-1).

respawn_delay_s.description: Wait after losing a unit before the next JOIN, unit s of game time (GAMEPLAY GP-2, Q-ALN-5).

max_viewer_units.description: Live viewer (COMMANDER-owned, AUTO included) units before JOINs queue, unit units (GAMEPLAY GP-3, Q-ALN-9).

reserve_queue_max.description: Reserve queue entries before a JOIN is rejected RESERVE_QUEUE_FULL, unit entries (GAMEPLAY GP-3).

Director.description: Threat Director part 1 (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §6.7, THREAT-DIRECTOR §2-§5a, Q-SIM-78; NX-151, NX-155). Durations are game time, converted to ticks at load.

window_s.description: The decision window: CP, provocation, tier and budget update once per window, unit s of game time (TD-1, Q-ALN-23).

unit_value.description: CP points of one currently tracked coalition unit, by kind; one entry per coalition-side kind in the unit catalog (the loader refuses a missing one); every other kind counts 0.

STRIKE_FIGHTER.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

RECON_UAV.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

LOGI_TRUCK.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

GARRISON_INFANTRY.description: CP points of one tracked unit of this kind.

ema_window_s.description: The EMA window of coalition power, unit s of game time (Q-ALN-23).

bravo_enter_cp.description: Smoothed CP at which the CP ceiling rises to BRAVO, unit CP points.

exit_ratio.description: A level (CP ceiling or provocation) drops only below its threshold times this, unit fraction of the enter value.

min_dwell_s.description: The least time in a tier before it may change, unit s of game time.

half_life_s.description: The score halves over this long, unit s of game time.

escalate_threshold.description: Provocation at which the level reaches ALPHA, unit provocation points.

bravo_threshold.description: Provocation at which the level reaches BRAVO (above escalate_threshold; the loader checks), unit provocation points.

weights.description: Points per sensed or suffered action caused by a player-controlled unit.

unit_destroyed.description: A Static unit destroyed by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

unit_damaged.description: One hit on a Static unit (not a convoy or a facility) by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

convoy_hit.description: One hit on a Static convoy (a carrier kind) by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

facility_damaged.description: One hit on a Static facility by a player-controlled unit, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

facility_disabled.description: A Static facility brought to Disabled by a player-controlled unit (replaces the hit's facility_damaged), unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

base_captured.description: A Static base flipped to the coalition by a capture with at least one commander in radius, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

scout_in_rear.description: A player-controlled coalition scout the Static tracks in its rear, once per decision window, unit provocation points (Q-SIM-78, Q-TD-11).

redemption.description: Provocation of a channel-point redemption by class (Q-AI-9, Q-ALN-13); no redemption command exists yet, so the weights are read by `provocation.redemption_weight` only.

support.description: A support redemption (supply drop, respawn skip, queue jump), unit provocation points.

cosmetic.description: A cosmetic redemption (color, ping, shoutout, spectacle), unit provocation points.

budget.description: The most budget points one decision window can spend, by tier (Q-TD-5); also capped by the real surplus of the Static's bases.

pattern_of_life.description: Budget points per window in this tier.

alpha.description: Budget points per window in this tier.

bravo.description: Budget points per window in this tier.

max_spawns_per_window.description: The most new Static units per window (Q-TD-12); read by spawning, which is not built yet.

max_live_units.description: The most live Static units by tier (Q-TD-12); read by spawning, which is not built yet.

pattern_of_life.description: Live Static units allowed in this tier.

alpha.description: Live Static units allowed in this tier.

bravo.description: Live Static units allowed in this tier.
